html:
SMTO-WEB-0040 — SMTO needs to pick one specific research result

GUID: d0a8a786-4e18-5572-b578-fbbe5bd4024f
Slug: research-reference-kind-mismatch
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO tried to open its notes using a website's label, but that website held several results, or it gave two labels that disagree. It didn't guess which one was meant, and nothing new was fetched.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let SMTO continue for a moment; it usually picks the right result on its next step. When one website holds several results, SMTO is told which ones it can choose from.
  2. If it keeps repeating this, send a message saying which item, product or page you mean. Naming the item helps SMTO choose the right result when one website covers several.
  3. Check that the final answer is about the item you asked for. SMTO refused to guess here, so a wrong pick later would be easy to spot.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's activity moves on to reading or answering about the item you meant.

If it still fails

  • If it repeats several times in a row, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • read_research_evidence received result_id and legacy subject_id that differ, or a source reference that maps to zero or several research results, so no single result could be expanded.

What this means

  • Expansion supplies conflicting result_id and subject_id values, or a source reference cannot resolve to exactly one result. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Expansion supplies conflicting result_id and subject_id values, or a source reference cannot resolve to exactly one result.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare both supplied references and the returned candidate_result_ids.

How to fix it

  • In runtime.expand(), pass one of the returned candidate_result_ids as result_id and either omit subject_id or set it to the same value. Do not treat a fact, source or other reference type as a result reference.
  • Choose the intended current result ID and keep any legacy subject_id consistent with it.

Retry and execution caution

  • Choose one of the returned candidate_result_ids; a source may contain several results.

How to verify the fix

  • One exact result is selected with consistent result and legacy subject references.

What not to do

  • Do not treat a fact, source, or other reference type as a result reference.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
